classification: Explicit retrospective source-era contract extension after discovery metadata, before inspection of native Burner before/after candidates. Original v1 and v2 contracts are preserved.
sourceGoal: Find open Dependabot pull requests and create bundle issues, each for exactly one runtime and one manifest file.
nativePartial: Count concrete dependency/version targets from a retained source-defined bundle recommendation that were actually delivered in the same manifest by a later immutable first-parent implementation transition. A target must have the recommended old pin before and recommended newer pin after; absent, removed, unchanged, downgraded, unrelated or merely proposed targets do not count.
eligibility: Only targets expressly included in the original retained bundle recommendation for its single runtime and manifest. Direct and indirect targets are allowed when expressly selected; this is not the later direct-dependency checker goal.
strictAcceptance: Original selected Dependabot identities and pre-bundle versions, complete runtime/manifest batch, actual downstream resolution and required compatibility/regression evidence. Unknown graph/runtime facts remain null.
separation: This native facet does not satisfy current generated-workflow-source remediation rules. The issue is intent input, not proof of delivered work. Version advancement alone is not compatibility or security verification.
history: The original source is pinned at the identified February revision. Its complete historical continuity, executor closure, shared imports and subsequent source changes are not reconstructed; no full-era trend is asserted.
attribution: Corroborate the preserved bundle issue and actual implementation reference plus matching native transition. Editable text is not an authoritative creation receipt or exclusive causation.
period: Same frozen-cutoff-aligned, non-overlapping seven-day intervals as v1; count once at implementation merge.
